title: VA-Approved Condos in Myrtle Beach: How to Check
description: Using a VA loan on a Myrtle Beach condo? How to check if the building is VA-approved, what VA reviews, and your options if it isn't on the list.
h1: VA-Approved Condos in Myrtle Beach: How to Check Before You Buy
dek: The building has to be approved before the unit can get a VA loan. Here's how to check, and what to do if it isn't.
railHead: Buying a condo with a VA loan?

faq.q: Can you use a VA loan to buy a condo?
faq.a: Yes, if VA has approved the condo project. VA reviews the condo's legal documents before it will guarantee a loan on any unit in it.

faq.q: How do I find VA-approved condos?
faq.a: Search VA's Condo Report at lgy.va.gov by the condo's name, city or county. It also lists rejected and pending projects, so read the status, or tick "Approved" to see only approved ones.

faq.q: What if the condo isn't VA-approved?
faq.a: The condo's documents can be sent to VA for review, which takes time and the association's help. Or you can compare an FHA loan, a conventional loan or a non-warrantable condo loan.

faq.q: Can I use a VA loan on a beach condo I'll rent out?
faq.a: No. A VA loan is for a home you intend to live in, and you certify that when you apply and at closing. A second home or rental needs a different loan.
